features: Analog Turbo HD ColorVu 3.0 pan-tilt turret — 1 HD analog output over coax; NOT an IP camera
Smart-Hybrid light: up to 30 m white light and 30 m IR
Built-in mic and speaker with two-way audio over coaxial cable
Active strobe (red/blue flashing) light and audible alarm deterrence
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2CE67DV3T-PTLXTS is an analog Turbo HD 2MP ColorVu 3.0 pan-tilt turret with 24/7 full-color imaging (F1.0), Smart-Hybrid light (30 m white / 30 m IR), 130 dB WDR, two-way audio over coax and active strobe/audio deterrence. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet (DS-2CE67DV3T-PTLXTS_Datasheet_20260714.pdf).
